Name: Cloudflare - Purge Cache
Description:
Purges the [Cloudflare](https://www.cloudflare.com) cache for a zone via the [cache purge API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/) — typically run after a deployment so visitors get fresh content immediately.

Supports purging everything, or purging selectively by URL, cache-tag, hostname, or URL prefix (all methods are available on every Cloudflare plan; purge rate limits vary by plan). Lists longer than the API limit of 30 items per request are purged automatically in batches.

Requires `curl` and either `jq` or `python3` on the worker.

Properties.Octopus.Action.Script.ScriptBody:
#!/bin/bash

# Cloudflare - Purge Cache
# Purges the Cloudflare cache for a zone via the REST API.
# API reference: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/

# Read step parameters
ApiToken=$(get_octopusvariable "CloudflarePurge.ApiToken")
ZoneId=$(get_octopusvariable "CloudflarePurge.ZoneId")
PurgeType=$(get_octopusvariable "CloudflarePurge.PurgeType")
PurgeItems=$(get_octopusvariable "CloudflarePurge.Items")

# Validate required tooling

if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: curl is required on the worker to run this step." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  JSON_TOOL="jq"
elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  JSON_TOOL="python3"
else
  echo "ERROR: jq or python3 is required on the worker to build and parse JSON." >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Prints the JSON-encoded (quoted) form of $1
json_escape() {
  if [[ "$JSON_TOOL" == "jq" ]]; then
    jq -cn --arg v "$1" '$v'
  else
    python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps(sys.argv[1]))' "$1"
  fi
}

# Reads JSON on stdin and prints the value at dotted path $1 (empty if missing
# or null; numeric path parts index into arrays)
json_get() {
  if [[ "$JSON_TOOL" == "jq" ]]; then
    jq -r "getpath(\"$1\" | split(\".\") | map(if test(\"^[0-9]+$\") then tonumber else . end)) // empty" 2>/dev/null
  else
    python3 -c '
import json, sys
try:
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception:
    sys.exit(0)
cur = data
for part in sys.argv[1].split("."):
    if isinstance(cur, dict) and part in cur:
        cur = cur[part]
    elif isinstance(cur, list) and part.isdigit() and int(part) < len(cur):
        cur = cur[int(part)]
    else:
        sys.exit(0)
if cur is None:
    sys.exit(0)
print(cur if not isinstance(cur, (dict, list)) else json.dumps(cur))
' "$1"
  fi
}

# Validate required parameters

if [[ -z "$ApiToken" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: API Token is required." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [[ -z "$ZoneId" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: Zone ID is required." >&2
  exit 1
fi

PurgeType=$(echo "$PurgeType" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
[[ -z "$PurgeType" ]] && PurgeType="everything"

case "$PurgeType" in
  everything|files|tags|hosts|prefixes) ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: Unsupported Purge Type '$PurgeType'. Must be one of: everything, files, tags, hosts, prefixes." >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

# Parse the item list (newline- and comma-separated, blanks ignored)

ITEMS=()
if [[ "$PurgeType" != "everything" ]]; then
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    line=$(echo "$line" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')
    [[ -n "$line" ]] && ITEMS+=("$line")
  done < <(echo "$PurgeItems" | tr ',' '\n')

  if (( ${#ITEMS[@]} == 0 )); then
    echo "ERROR: Purge Type '$PurgeType' requires at least one item in Items to Purge." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# Sends one purge request with body $1, retrying on rate limiting (HTTP 429).
API_URL="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/${ZoneId}/purge_cache"

purge_request() {
  local body="$1"
  local max_attempts=3
  local attempt=1

  while true; do
    RAW=$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 60 --write-out $'\n%{http_code}' \
      --request POST "$API_URL" \
      --header "Authorization: Bearer $ApiToken" \
      --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
      --data "$body")

    local curl_exit=$?

    if [[ $curl_exit -ne 0 ]]; then
      echo "ERROR: curl request failed (exit code $curl_exit)." >&2
      exit 1
    fi

    HTTP_STATUS=$(echo "$RAW" | tail -n 1)
    RESPONSE=$(echo "$RAW" | sed '$d')

    if [[ "$HTTP_STATUS" == "429" ]]; then
      if (( attempt >= max_attempts )); then
        echo "ERROR: Cloudflare rate limited the purge request and retries were exhausted." >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      local wait_seconds=$((attempt * 5))
      echo "Rate limited (429); retrying in ${wait_seconds}s (attempt $((attempt + 1))/${max_attempts})..."
      sleep "$wait_seconds"
      attempt=$((attempt + 1))
      continue
    fi

    break
  done

  SUCCESS=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | json_get "success")

  if [[ "$HTTP_STATUS" -ge 400 || "$SUCCESS" != "True" && "$SUCCESS" != "true" ]]; then
    ERROR_CODE=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | json_get "errors.0.code")
    ERROR_MSG=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | json_get "errors.0.message")
    echo "ERROR: Cloudflare API returned an error (HTTP $HTTP_STATUS)." >&2
    [[ -n "$ERROR_CODE" ]] && echo "  Code   : $ERROR_CODE" >&2
    [[ -n "$ERROR_MSG" ]] && echo "  Message: $ERROR_MSG" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

# Purge

echo "Purging Cloudflare cache..."
echo "  Zone : $ZoneId"
echo "  Type : $PurgeType"

if [[ "$PurgeType" == "everything" ]]; then
  echo ""
  purge_request '{"purge_everything":true}'
else
  echo "  Items: ${#ITEMS[@]}"
  echo ""

  # The API accepts at most 30 items per request, so purge in batches
  BATCH_SIZE=30
  TOTAL=${#ITEMS[@]}
  OFFSET=0
  BATCH_NUM=1

  while (( OFFSET < TOTAL )); do
    BATCH=("${ITEMS[@]:$OFFSET:$BATCH_SIZE}")

    ENCODED=()
    for item in "${BATCH[@]}"; do
      ENCODED+=("$(json_escape "$item")")
    done

    BODY="{\"$PurgeType\":[$(IFS=,; echo "${ENCODED[*]}")]}"

    if (( TOTAL > BATCH_SIZE )); then
      if (( ${#BATCH[@]} == 1 )); then
        echo "Batch $BATCH_NUM (1 item)..."
      else
        echo "Batch $BATCH_NUM (${#BATCH[@]} items)..."
      fi
    fi

    purge_request "$BODY"

    OFFSET=$((OFFSET + BATCH_SIZE))
    BATCH_NUM=$((BATCH_NUM + 1))
  done
fi

echo "Cache purged successfully."

Parameters.Name: CloudflarePurge.ApiToken
Parameters.Label: API Token
Parameters.HelpText: A Cloudflare [API token](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/) with the `Zone → Cache Purge → Purge` permission for the zone. Consider binding this to a sensitive project variable (e.g. `#{Cloudflare.ApiToken}`) so it can be scoped and rotated in one place.

Parameters.Name: CloudflarePurge.ZoneId
Parameters.Label: Zone ID
Parameters.HelpText: The zone ID of the domain, shown in the **API** section of the domain's Overview page in the Cloudflare dashboard.

Parameters.Name: CloudflarePurge.PurgeType
Parameters.Label: Purge Type
Parameters.HelpText: What to purge. `Everything` clears the entire cache for the zone. The selective options purge only the entries listed in Items to Purge.

DisplaySettings.Octopus.SelectOptions:
everything|Everything
files|By URL
tags|By cache-tag
hosts|By hostname
prefixes|By URL prefix

Parameters.Name: CloudflarePurge.Items
Parameters.Label: Items to Purge
Parameters.HelpText: The URLs, cache-tags, hostnames, or prefixes to purge — one per line (comma-separated also accepted). Ignored when Purge Type is `Everything`. URLs must be absolute (e.g. `https://example.com/styles.css`). More than 30 items are purged in batches of 30 automatically.
